tr.description:
Welcome to This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker - a unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?
Steam: Very Positive, 89%

GROW YOUR HAND
Buy new cards to increase your odds of hitting good hands. If you're rich enough, you can even break the rules and get over 5 cards.

ESTABLISH DOMINANCE
Even though the Jester doesn't like it, you can buy new decks of cards in order to play more hands at once. Use this to your advantage to grow those numbers even faster!

GET UPGRADED
Buy powerful upgrades using your hard earned coins, enabling you to progress quicker, open up new avenues, and take on the evil Jester!

GO ON EXPEDITIONS
Once unlocked, you can send your minions on expeditions to discover new otherworldy cards with powerful benefits. Upgrade these missions to provide even more powerful benefits as you progress. You can even unlock missions to destroy cards from your deck that you don't want, to ensure every hand is exactly how you want it.

ASCEND TO GREATNESS
Make a deal with the Jester to start over in exchange for Poker Chips (poker chips? But this ain't even poker...?), use those chips to buy even more powerful upgrades.

ESCAPE THE HOUSE OF CARDS
You're trapped in the Jester's domain, can you manage to defeat him and escape? Or will he keep you there, trapped forever in an endless cycle?

tr.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加
• 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记

—— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 ——
• 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分
• 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对
• 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录
• 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放

—— 学生积分（可选开启）——
• 点名加减分、规则可配
• 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感
• 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励

—— 备份、导出与多端 ——
• 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入
• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控
• 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单

“Trials of Mana,” the hit console game with over 1 million copies and downloads sold worldwide...is coming to a smartphone near you!

Fun for longtime fans of the Mana Series and new players alike!

◆Story
When the world was shrouded in darkness, the Goddess of Mana drew forth the Sword of Mana to smite the eight Benevodons, monsters of destruction. She sealed the horrors inside the eight Mana Stones, bringing the realm back from the brink.

Weak from rebuilding the world, the Goddess changed into a tree and fell fast asleep for years. However, the forces of evil sought to free the Benevodons to gain control of the world. They started a terrible war to further their plot and destabilize the kingdoms.
Peace was at an end.

Mana itself began to disappear from the world and the Mana Tree to wither...

◆Playable Characters
Players start their adventure by selecting three of the six main characters. The overlapping story of interwoven destinies changes depending on who you choose as your main character and companions!

◆Graphics
See the spectacular world of Mana in full 3D render! Scenes and characters from the original game now in beautifully detailed graphics.

◆Battle System
Use the dynamic fighting system to evade enemies and fight back with aerial and combo attacks. Utilize the signature ring menus of the Mana Series and new shortcut commands.

◆Powering Up Characters
Switch to light or dark classes to strengthen your characters and change their look. In this remake, there’s also a newly added Class 4. With over 300 different kinds of abilities available, there are many different ways to train and power up your characters.

◆Difficulty
You have the option of four difficulty settings: Beginner, Easy, Normal, and Hard. The Beginner setting allows players to resume in the same spot no matter how many times they get a game over. If you find action games hard or want to focus on the story, select this difficulty.

◆Soundtrack
The 60-song soundtrack features arrangements overseen by the original composer, Hiroki Kikuta. Players can switch the BGM to the new version or the SNES version.

◆Voiceover
Full voiceover in English and Japanese! The characters in your party determine which extra conversations happen during your journey.

◆New Game Plus
After you beat the game once, you will unlock new storylines for your party members. You can unlock harder difficulties like Expert and the No Future after playing through the new storylines.

◆New Features
Included in the game is the option to play through flashbacks for each character in your party. You’ll also see a familiar Mana Series face when searching for Li’l Cactus during your adventures. Plus, there are additions like a new type of item seed and the autosave feature.

・Menus are touch-operated. Control characters with the directional pad overlay display.
・Newly added features like auto-target, auto-camera, and auto-battle.
・Graphic quality options available.

・A Wi-Fi connection is highly recommended when downloading the app.

Journey to the forgotten past, to the far future, and to the end of time. A big adventure to save the planet, now begins…

CHRONO TRIGGER is the timeless role-playing classic developed by the ‘Dream Team’ of DRAGON QUEST creator Yuji Horii, Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama, and the creators of FINAL FANTASY. As the story unfolds, embark on a journey to different eras: the present, the middle ages, the future, prehistory, and ancient times! Whether you're a first-time player or a longtime fan, this epic quest to save a planet's future promises hours of enthralling adventure!

As the definitive version of CHRONO TRIGGER, not only have the controls been updated, the graphics and sound have also been revamped to make your adventure even more fun and enjoyable to play. To complete your journey, also included is the mysterious ‘Dimensional Vortex’ dungeon and the forgotten ‘Lost Sanctum’ dungeon. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

Story:
A chance encounter amid the festivities of Guardia's Millennial Fair in Leene Square introduces our young hero, Crono, to a girl by the name of Marle. Deciding to explore the fair together, the two soon find themselves at an exhibition of the Telepod, the latest invention by Crono's longtime friend Lucca. Marle, fearless and brimming with curiosity, volunteers to assist in a demonstration. An unanticipated malfunction, however, sends her hurtling through a rift in the dimensions. Taking hold of the girl's pendant, Crono bravely follows in pursuit. But the world into which he emerges is the one of four centuries before. Journey to the forgotten past, the distant future, and even to the very End of Time. The epic quest to save a planet's future makes history once again.

Key features:

Active Time Battle Version 2
During battle, time will not stop, and you can enter commands when the character's gauge is full. The enemies' positions will change as time passes, so choose your actions based on any given situation.

‘Tech’ moves and combos
During battle, you can unleash special ‘Tech’ moves, including abilities and/or magic and characters can combine these abilities to unleash all new combo attacks which are unique to them. There are over 50 different types of combos that you can execute between two and three characters!

Experience the 'Dimensional Vortex' and the 'Lost Sanctum' dungeons
The Dimensional Vortex: a mysterious, ever-changing dungeon existing outside of space and time. What wonders await you at its center? The Lost Sanctum: enigmatic gates in prehistoric and medieval times will lead you to these forgotten chambers. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

Graphics and sound
While keeping the atmosphere of the original, the graphics have been updated in higher resolution. As for the sound and music, under the supervision of composer Yasunori Mitsuda, all songs have been updated for an even more immersive gameplay experience.

Autosave
In addition to saving at a save point or choosing to quit from the menu, your progress is saved automatically while traversing the map.

tr.description:
Heart Murmurs Pro is a cardiac auscultation trainer for medical and nursing students, residents, and anyone studying how to tell heart sounds apart by ear.

Listen to 24 heart sounds and murmurs. For each one, see a labelled waveform showing exactly where the sound falls in the cardiac cycle, a diagram of the auscultation site it belongs to, and the study notes that go with it — then test yourself.

This is a study aid, not a clinical tool. Nothing in it is meant to guide decisions about a real patient's care.

FREE TO TRY

Five sounds are free — normal, aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, mitral stenosis and the S3 gallop — each with its waveform, its auscultation site and its study notes, and you can quiz yourself on them. One purchase unlocks the other 19 sounds and the study tools described below. No subscription.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• 24 heart sounds and murmurs — from normal S1/S2 to aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, pericardial friction rub and summation gallop
• A labelled waveform for every sound, with systole and diastole marked and S1, S2, A2, P2, ejection clicks, opening snaps and gallops called out where they actually occur
• Half-speed playback, for murmurs that go by too fast at full speed
• Compare any two sounds — a murmur against normal, or against the one you keep mistaking it for — and switch between them with one tap
• Auscultation site diagrams showing where each sound is heard best
• Seven sections of study notes per sound: description, etiology, pathophysiology, physical examination, diagnostic evaluation, clinical presentation and treatment
• Room for your own notes on any sound

QUIZ YOURSELF

Choose which murmurs you want in the pool — everything, one of the built-in sets, your favorites, or a handful you pick — then choose how many questions and start. Five for a quick drill, twenty when you have time. Answer from six options, or name it yourself and score your own recall.

Switch on re-asking and a murmur you miss comes back a few questions later, because that is the one you needed to hear again. At the end you get your score and, more usefully, the list of what you missed — with a button to practice exactly those. Every murmur keeps its own record, so the app can show you where you are weak and build a session out of it.

BUILT FOR STUDYING

• Works completely offline — no account, no sign-in, nothing to set up
• Free to download; one purchase unlocks everything, with no subscription and no ads
• English, Spanish and Simplified Chinese
• Full split-view layout on iPad
• Dark Mode
• Favorites and search across the whole library
• A cardiac exam guide covering auscultation technique, the five listening areas, and the eight characteristics used to describe a murmur

Headphones are strongly recommended. Phone speakers roll off the low frequencies that carry S3, S4 and mitral stenosis.

Heart Murmurs Pro is an educational tool for learning cardiac auscultation. It is not a diagnostic device and must not be used to diagnose or treat anyone, or to guide decisions about a patient's care. Always defer to your training, your supervisors, and your institution's protocols.

tr.description:
「拦截猫」是一款在设备本地运行的 "骚扰电话" 与 "垃圾短信" 拦截 APP。

拦截过程在设备本地完成，无需上传短信内容或来电信息，也不会获取任何通讯录数据。

你只需要完成一次设置，剩下的交给拦截猫。

【核心功能】

AI 模型和电话数据持续更新，不断提升短信识别与电话拦截效果。

【隐私保护】

短信过滤和电话拦截均在设备本地完成，日常拦截无需上传短信内容或来电信息。

拦截猫不申请通讯录权限，不会读取、收集或上传任何通讯录数据。

tr.description:
"Cytus II" is a music rhythm game created by Rayark Games. It's our fourth rhythm game title, following the footsteps of three global successes, "Cytus", "DEEMO" and "VOEZ". This sequel to "Cytus" brings back the original staff and is a product of hardwork and devotion. 

In the future, humans have redefined internet development and connections. We can now easily sync the real world with the internet world, changing life as we have known for thousands of years. 

In the mega virtual internet space cyTus, there exists a mysterious DJ legend Æsir. His music has an irresistible charm; people fall madly in love with his music. Rumor has it that every note and beat of his music hits the audiences in 
the depths of their souls. 

One day, Æsir, who had never shown his face before, suddenly announced that he will be holding the first mega virtual concert —— Æsir-FEST and will invite a top idol singer and a popular DJ as opening performances. The instant the ticket sales began, an unprecedented rush occurred. Everyone wanted to see Æsir's real face. 

On the day of the FEST,  millions of people were connected to the event. At one hour before the event started,  the previous world record for most simultaneous connection was smashed. The whole city was on its feet, waiting for Æsir to descent from the skies...

Game Features:

- The unique "Active Judgement Line" rhythm game playstyle
Tap the notes as the judgement line hits them to achieve a high score. Through five different kinds of notes and the judgement line that actively adjusts its speed according to the beat, the gameplay experience is further combined with the music. Players can easily immerse themselves in the songs. 

- A total of 250+ high-quality songs (50+ in base game, 200+ as IAP)
The game includes songs by composers from all across the world, Japan, Korea, the US, Europe, Taiwan and more. Through the characters, players get to play songs from different genres including but not limited to: electronic, rock and classical. We are confident that this game will live up to the hype and expectations.

- Over 800 different charts
Over 800 different charts designed, from easy to hard. The rich game content can satisfy players of different levels. Experience exciting challenges and enjoyment through the sensation of your fingertips. 

- Explore the virtual internet world with the game's characters
The one-of-a-kind story system "iM" will lead the players and the in-game characters to slowly piece together the story and world behind "Cytus II". Reveal the truth of the story with a rich, cinematic visual experience.

tr.description:
A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated

Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps.

This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher.

Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done.

You get:

- Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps
- Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need
- Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message
- Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand
- Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus
- Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision
- Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities
- Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions
- Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have

Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price.

With Goblin Tools Pro, you can:

- Keep your data continuously synced between devices
- Create and reuse templates for to-do items
- Share the lists you create
- Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice
- Access your history across all Goblin Tools
- Use additional Pro features as they are introduced

Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate.

It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more.

Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

Experimente um mundo devastado pela humanidade pelos olhos da última raposa da Terra nesta aventura ecológica.

pt.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加

• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控

—— 特别说明 ——
• 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明
• 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接

pt.description:
Já imaginou como é estar na linha da frente da segurança nacional?

Em Black Border 2, você assume o papel de um agente da Polícia de Fronteira, enfrentando situações desafiantes a cada turno. Com visuais detalhados e jogabilidade envolvente, este jogo oferece uma experiência realista incomparável que coloca você no centro da ação.

Assuma a responsabilidade de proteger as fronteiras do seu país contra o contrabando ilegal. Inspecione veículos, reveja documentos e enfrente contrabandistas que tentam traficar drogas, armas e outras mercadorias ilegais.

Cada dia traz novos desafios, onde pensamento rápido e visão aguçada são as suas melhores ferramentas. Você é mais do que um simples agente de fronteira — você é a última linha de defesa.

    Deteção de contrabando: Realize buscas minuciosas em veículos e inspeções pessoais para capturar criminosos que tentam contrabandear mercadorias ilegais.

    Personagens dinâmicos com IA: Interaja com personagens realistas que reagem e se adaptam com base nas suas decisões e ações.

    Desafios crescentes: Desde pequenos erros em documentos até grandes redes de contrabando, enfrente missões cada vez mais intensas que vão testar os seus limites.

Outline

The smash hit RPG: Final Fantasy VII, which has sold over 11,000,000 units* worldwide, finally arrives on iOS!
*Total includes both packaged sales and downloads.

The first Final Fantasy to feature 3D backgrounds and CG movie scenes, this dramatic tale continues to be loved by numerous fans around the world. Battle stages also appear in full 3D for the first time, bringing an even greater sense of awe and spectacle to combat!

Customize your characters in any way you like using the fantastic “material” system that allows endless combinations of spells and abilities.

This product is a port based on Final Fantasy VII for PC (No changes or additions have been made to the story). 


Story

With its unshakeable monopoly over Mako energy production, the evil Shinra Electric Power Company holds tight to the reigns of world power.
One day, a Mako reactor serving the sprawling metropolis of Midgar is attacked and destroyed in a bombing raid by a revolutionary group calling themselves Avalanche. 
Cloud Strife, a former member of Shinra’s elite “Soldier” unit takes part in the raid as a mercenary hired by Avalanche and sets events in motion that will draw him and his friends into an epic struggle for the fate of the planet itself…


Special features for the iOS edition 

- Play using a simple and comfortable virtual controller designed not to obscure the action, choosing between virtual analogue or fixed 4-way digital control pad options. The opacity of on-screen controls can also be adjusted from the Config Menu.

- Two new features to make play easier and more convenient!
The iOS edition also includes an option to turn enemy encounters off on the world and area maps (will not skip event battles) and a Max Stats command to become all-powerful in the blink of an eye.


Major game controls

Movement: Virtual joypad (Select between analogue and digital modes)
Menu navigation: Fixed digital buttons
Confirm: A button
Cancel: B button
Open menu: Y button

pt.description:
“Trials of Mana,” the hit console game with over 1 million copies and downloads sold worldwide...is coming to a smartphone near you!

Fun for longtime fans of the Mana Series and new players alike!

◆Story
When the world was shrouded in darkness, the Goddess of Mana drew forth the Sword of Mana to smite the eight Benevodons, monsters of destruction. She sealed the horrors inside the eight Mana Stones, bringing the realm back from the brink.

Weak from rebuilding the world, the Goddess changed into a tree and fell fast asleep for years. However, the forces of evil sought to free the Benevodons to gain control of the world. They started a terrible war to further their plot and destabilize the kingdoms.
Peace was at an end.

Mana itself began to disappear from the world and the Mana Tree to wither...

◆Playable Characters
Players start their adventure by selecting three of the six main characters. The overlapping story of interwoven destinies changes depending on who you choose as your main character and companions!

◆Graphics
See the spectacular world of Mana in full 3D render! Scenes and characters from the original game now in beautifully detailed graphics.

◆Battle System
Use the dynamic fighting system to evade enemies and fight back with aerial and combo attacks. Utilize the signature ring menus of the Mana Series and new shortcut commands.

◆Powering Up Characters
Switch to light or dark classes to strengthen your characters and change their look. In this remake, there’s also a newly added Class 4. With over 300 different kinds of abilities available, there are many different ways to train and power up your characters.

◆Difficulty
You have the option of four difficulty settings: Beginner, Easy, Normal, and Hard. The Beginner setting allows players to resume in the same spot no matter how many times they get a game over. If you find action games hard or want to focus on the story, select this difficulty.

◆Soundtrack
The 60-song soundtrack features arrangements overseen by the original composer, Hiroki Kikuta. Players can switch the BGM to the new version or the SNES version.

◆Voiceover
Full voiceover in English and Japanese! The characters in your party determine which extra conversations happen during your journey.

◆New Game Plus
After you beat the game once, you will unlock new storylines for your party members. You can unlock harder difficulties like Expert and the No Future after playing through the new storylines.

◆New Features
Included in the game is the option to play through flashbacks for each character in your party. You’ll also see a familiar Mana Series face when searching for Li’l Cactus during your adventures. Plus, there are additions like a new type of item seed and the autosave feature.

◆Smartphone-Specific
・Menus are touch-operated. Control characters with the directional pad overlay display.
・Newly added features like auto-target, auto-camera, and auto-battle.
・Graphic quality options available.
・Cloud save compatible.
・Can obtain the starting gear “Rabite Adornment,“ which increases the EXP gained in battle up to level 17 and “Silktail Adornment,” which increases the amount of lucre gained in battle up to level 17.

【App Download】
・This application is approximately 6.7GB in total. Please ensure you have the necessary storage space available on your device before purchasing.
・After starting the game, a large portion of data must be downloaded after defeating the first boss. You can also select “Download” on the title screen to download the entire app at once.
・A Wi-Fi connection is highly recommended when downloading the app. 

【Players】
1

【Recommended Devices】
iPhone 7 and above

When darkness falls and the land is robbed of light, four youths are chosen by the crystals to embark upon a journey to save the world.

FINAL FANTASY III was the first title in the FINAL FANTASY series to become a million-seller, establishing once and for all that Square Enix's classic RPG saga was here to stay.

pt.description:
Journey to the forgotten past, to the far future, and to the end of time. A big adventure to save the planet, now begins…

CHRONO TRIGGER is the timeless role-playing classic developed by the ‘Dream Team’ of DRAGON QUEST creator Yuji Horii, Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama, and the creators of FINAL FANTASY. As the story unfolds, embark on a journey to different eras: the present, the middle ages, the future, prehistory, and ancient times! Whether you're a first-time player or a longtime fan, this epic quest to save a planet's future promises hours of enthralling adventure!

As the definitive version of CHRONO TRIGGER, not only have the controls been updated, the graphics and sound have also been revamped to make your adventure even more fun and enjoyable to play. To complete your journey, also included is the mysterious ‘Dimensional Vortex’ dungeon and the forgotten ‘Lost Sanctum’ dungeon. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

Story:
A chance encounter amid the festivities of Guardia's Millennial Fair in Leene Square introduces our young hero, Crono, to a girl by the name of Marle. Deciding to explore the fair together, the two soon find themselves at an exhibition of the Telepod, the latest invention by Crono's longtime friend Lucca. Marle, fearless and brimming with curiosity, volunteers to assist in a demonstration. An unanticipated malfunction, however, sends her hurtling through a rift in the dimensions. Taking hold of the girl's pendant, Crono bravely follows in pursuit. But the world into which he emerges is the one of four centuries before. Journey to the forgotten past, the distant future, and even to the very End of Time. The epic quest to save a planet's future makes history once again.

Key features:

Active Time Battle Version 2
During battle, time will not stop, and you can enter commands when the character's gauge is full. The enemies' positions will change as time passes, so choose your actions based on any given situation.

‘Tech’ moves and combos
During battle, you can unleash special ‘Tech’ moves, including abilities and/or magic and characters can combine these abilities to unleash all new combo attacks which are unique to them. There are over 50 different types of combos that you can execute between two and three characters!

Experience the 'Dimensional Vortex' and the 'Lost Sanctum' dungeons
The Dimensional Vortex: a mysterious, ever-changing dungeon existing outside of space and time. What wonders await you at its center? The Lost Sanctum: enigmatic gates in prehistoric and medieval times will lead you to these forgotten chambers. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

Graphics and sound
While keeping the atmosphere of the original, the graphics have been updated in higher resolution. As for the sound and music, under the supervision of composer Yasunori Mitsuda, all songs have been updated for an even more immersive gameplay experience.

Autosave
In addition to saving at a save point or choosing to quit from the menu, your progress is saved automatically while traversing the map.

pt.description:
Heart Murmurs Pro is a cardiac auscultation trainer for medical and nursing students, residents, and anyone studying how to tell heart sounds apart by ear.

Listen to 24 heart sounds and murmurs. For each one, see a labelled waveform showing exactly where the sound falls in the cardiac cycle, a diagram of the auscultation site it belongs to, and the study notes that go with it — then test yourself.

This is a study aid, not a clinical tool. Nothing in it is meant to guide decisions about a real patient's care.

FREE TO TRY

Five sounds are free — normal, aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, mitral stenosis and the S3 gallop — each with its waveform, its auscultation site and its study notes, and you can quiz yourself on them. One purchase unlocks the other 19 sounds and the study tools described below. No subscription.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• 24 heart sounds and murmurs — from normal S1/S2 to aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, pericardial friction rub and summation gallop
• A labelled waveform for every sound, with systole and diastole marked and S1, S2, A2, P2, ejection clicks, opening snaps and gallops called out where they actually occur
• Half-speed playback, for murmurs that go by too fast at full speed
• Compare any two sounds — a murmur against normal, or against the one you keep mistaking it for — and switch between them with one tap
• Auscultation site diagrams showing where each sound is heard best
• Seven sections of study notes per sound: description, etiology, pathophysiology, physical examination, diagnostic evaluation, clinical presentation and treatment
• Room for your own notes on any sound

QUIZ YOURSELF

Choose which murmurs you want in the pool — everything, one of the built-in sets, your favorites, or a handful you pick — then choose how many questions and start. Five for a quick drill, twenty when you have time. Answer from six options, or name it yourself and score your own recall.

Switch on re-asking and a murmur you miss comes back a few questions later, because that is the one you needed to hear again. At the end you get your score and, more usefully, the list of what you missed — with a button to practice exactly those. Every murmur keeps its own record, so the app can show you where you are weak and build a session out of it.

BUILT FOR STUDYING

• Works completely offline — no account, no sign-in, nothing to set up
• Free to download; one purchase unlocks everything, with no subscription and no ads
• English, Spanish and Simplified Chinese
• Full split-view layout on iPad
• Dark Mode
• Favorites and search across the whole library
• A cardiac exam guide covering auscultation technique, the five listening areas, and the eight characteristics used to describe a murmur

Headphones are strongly recommended. Phone speakers roll off the low frequencies that carry S3, S4 and mitral stenosis.

Heart Murmurs Pro is an educational tool for learning cardiac auscultation. It is not a diagnostic device and must not be used to diagnose or treat anyone, or to guide decisions about a patient's care. Always defer to your training, your supervisors, and your institution's protocols.
pt.releaseNotes:
Heart Murmurs Pro has been rebuilt from the ground up for modern iPhone and iPad. Everything you had is still here — your favorites, your notes, your quiz history and your custom quiz all carry over automatically.

NOW FREE TO DOWNLOAD
Heart Murmurs Pro is now free to try, with a single purchase to unlock the full library. If you bought the app before, nothing changes: everything stays unlocked. If anything ever shows a lock, tap Restore Purchases under Info.

REDRAWN WAVEFORMS
Every one of the 24 sounds now has a properly labelled waveform. Systole and diastole are marked, and S1, S2, A2, P2, ejection clicks, opening snaps and gallops appear where they actually occur in the cycle. Each one was reviewed against the clinical description of the murmur it belongs to.

A BETTER QUIZ
One screen instead of three: pick your murmurs, pick how many questions, start. Question count is no longer tied to how many sounds you chose, so a five-question drill is finally possible — and you can switch on re-asking, which brings a murmur you miss back later in the same run. Six options per question now. Your results list what you missed and offer to practice just those, and every murmur keeps its own record so you can see where you are weak.

NEW THROUGHOUT
• A new sound: hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, with its murmur drawn as it changes between standing and squatting
• Full split-view layout on iPad
• Dark Mode
• Search across the whole library
• Half-speed playback with a clearer control
• Compare any two sounds side by side, not just against normal, and switch between them with one tap
• A cardiac exam guide covering technique, the five listening areas, and the eight characteristics of a murmur
• Faster launch, and it now works entirely offline

Requires iOS 17 or later.

pt.description:
Vocês já está cansado das mesas velhas histórias? Você está interessado em jogos narrativos, romances gráficos, jogos baseados em chat e jogos indie, mas você está cansado da mesma coisa? Se sim, você deveria checar '7Days', um jogo de mistério com romance gráfico e baseado em decisões. 

'7Days' é um jogo narrativo de mistério com romance gráfico. É um jogo narrativo único baseado em decisões onde o usuário pode criar suas histórias baseadas na escolha que ele fizer.

Nós fornecemos a melhor experiência de um jogo narrativo com um enredo de mistério em estilo bate papo, projetado para dispositivos móveis. É um jogo altamente recomendado para você.

■ Jogo explicado
Toda escolha muda a sua história.
Cada pequena escolha irá mudar seu relacionamento com seus companheiros,
e altera seu destino e de seus companheiros nos momentos críticos.

Você pode ser o vilão ou um companheiro de confiança.
Tudo depende de suas escolhas.

■ Resumo
Existem espíritos que foram colocados ao testa para ressurreição no mundo da morte.
O mensageiro da morte os atribuiu com a tarefa de se atacarem ou trabalharem juntos. Seu personagem, Kirell, deve completar tambés as tarefas baseadas em escolhas que lhe foram atribuídas.
Mas suas tarefas necessitam que outros morram...

Você só tem 7 dias
O que você irá escolher?

Experimente está história que provoca a imaginação agora mesmo.

■ Características do jogo
- Estilo quadrinho com gráficos incríveis
- Enredo único que alterna entre a vida e a morte
- O enredo muda de acordo com suas escolhas
- Várias conquistas e desafios ocultos
- Episódios e finais diferentes baseados na história
- Aventura de texto com uma sensação misteriosa
- Enredo excitante

■ Recomendado para aqueles que:
- Estão interessados em conteúdo/texto interativo como romances gráficos, jogos narrativos, jogos de bate papo e jogos sociais
- São apaixonados por jogos indie como 'Undertale'
- Estão procurando por uma jogo narrativo com elementos de mistério e/ou terror
- Estão procurando por O jogo e estão cansados dos jogos narrativos de sempre
- Estão interessados em diferentes tipos de jogos de aventura
Nós também recomendamos 'Underworld Office: Ghost Game', outro de nossos grandes jogos.

■ Nós garantimos a diversão. Baixe e experimente agora

Se você encontrar algum problema ou tem alguma sugestão, por favor, envie para nós em help@buffstudio.com. Nós trabalhamos duro para fazer os melhores jogos de aventura, narrativos, indie, restauradores e romances gráficos.

■ Nós precisamos da sua ajuda para fazer jogos narrativos melhores. Por favor, recomende este jogo narrativo para sua família e amigos. Será de grande ajuda para nós.

pt.description:
**Bem-vindo ao Cytus Musical World** 

VEM SENTIR A MÚSICA E A ARTE, O RITMO E O SOM! 

Consulta as imagens e verás o mais ESPECTACULAR jogo de música para iOS de sempre! 
JOGA e DIVERTE-TE! 

*CARACTERÍSTICAS*

- Mais de 200 músicas e mais de 400 variações, incluindo muitas de compositores de renome de todo o mundo
 
- Ilustrações apelativas desenhadas à mão (tal como ilustrado nas imagens) 

- Sistema de Linha Activa fácil e intuitivo e 3 tipos de notas 

- Os diferentes modos de exibição permitem jogador pré-visualizar as notas facilmente 

- As fortes batidas e ritmos oferecem uma experiência satisfatória para o jogador 

- Mais de 9 níveis de dificuldade para mais diversão e desafios 

- Vários géneros musicais: POP, JAZZ, TRANCE, HARDCORE, DRUM 'N BASS e muito mais 

- Integração com as Tabelas de classificação do Center Leaderboards: Desafia jogadores de todo o mundo!

- Liga-te ao Facebook e mostra a tua destreza no Cytus 

*COMO JOGAR* 

- Segue a Linha Activa 

- Toca em cada nota à medida que a linha passa 

- Toca exactamente quando a linha estiver no centro da nota para obteres uma maior pontuação! 

*HISTÓRIA* 
Num futuro distante, os únicos seres sensíveis no mundo são robôs. 
São o último vestígio do espírito humano. 
No entanto, a humanidade não desapareceu por completo. 
Existe tecnologia capaz de transferir memórias para este robôs. 
Mas com espaço limitado, as novas memórias irão substituir gradualmente as mais antigas. 
Para evitar que as emoções nas memórias humanas desaparecessem, os robôs tiverem que converter as emoções em músicas e armazená-las num local chamado Cytus. 
Os robôs utilizam estas músicas para sentirem as emoções humanas e sonharem que cada um deles possui almas... 

Cytus

Site Oficial da Rayark: www.rayark.com
Follow Cytus https://twitter.com/CytusRayark
Like   Cytus http://www.facebook.com/rayark.Cytus

pt.description:
A história de Deemo e da garotinha chegou ao fim!

Da equipe de Cytus, um jogo de ritmo musical aclamado em todo o planeta.
A Rayark traz a você Deemo, um jogo híbrido de ritmos musicais e uma história de fantasia urbana, com arte desenhada a mão, uma galeria de narração e respostas instrumentais reais de sons de piano.

Deemo é um personagem místico que vive em solidão em um castelo. Um dia, uma garotinha cai do céu sem lembrar seu próprio nome ou de onde vem. Para ajudar a garotinha a voltar para o seu mundo, Deemo percebe que uma árvore cresce em cima do piano sempre que ele toca. O que Deemo fará quando ele se acostumar com a companhia que nunca teve antes? E se a garotinha não conseguir lidar com a verdade quando recuperar as suas memórias aparentemente perdidas?!

“Nunca partiu sem dizer adeus.”

Recursos:
- Desbloqueie mais faixas conforme o jogo progride
- 40 canções grátis no modo história
- Mais de 110 canções em vários gêneros musicais, muitos deles de compositores famosos
- Jogabilidade simples e intuitiva
- Reposta instrumental de piano real
- Busque por pistas na sala de estar e na biblioteca
- Integração dos Rankings de Líderes no Game Center: desafie jogadores de todo o planeta

pt.description:
"Cytus II" is a music rhythm game created by Rayark Games. It's our fourth rhythm game title, following the footsteps of three global successes, "Cytus", "DEEMO" and "VOEZ". This sequel to "Cytus" brings back the original staff and is a product of hardwork and devotion. 

In the future, humans have redefined internet development and connections. We can now easily sync the real world with the internet world, changing life as we have known for thousands of years. 

In the mega virtual internet space cyTus, there exists a mysterious DJ legend Æsir. His music has an irresistible charm; people fall madly in love with his music. Rumor has it that every note and beat of his music hits the audiences in 
the depths of their souls. 

One day, Æsir, who had never shown his face before, suddenly announced that he will be holding the first mega virtual concert —— Æsir-FEST and will invite a top idol singer and a popular DJ as opening performances. The instant the ticket sales began, an unprecedented rush occurred. Everyone wanted to see Æsir's real face. 

On the day of the FEST,  millions of people were connected to the event. At one hour before the event started,  the previous world record for most simultaneous connection was smashed. The whole city was on its feet, waiting for Æsir to descent from the skies...

Game Features:

- The unique "Active Judgement Line" rhythm game playstyle
Tap the notes as the judgement line hits them to achieve a high score. Through five different kinds of notes and the judgement line that actively adjusts its speed according to the beat, the gameplay experience is further combined with the music. Players can easily immerse themselves in the songs. 

- A total of 250+ high-quality songs (50+ in base game, 200+ as IAP)
The game includes songs by composers from all across the world, Japan, Korea, the US, Europe, Taiwan and more. Through the characters, players get to play songs from different genres including but not limited to: electronic, rock and classical. We are confident that this game will live up to the hype and expectations.

- Over 800 different charts
Over 800 different charts designed, from easy to hard. The rich game content can satisfy players of different levels. Experience exciting challenges and enjoyment through the sensation of your fingertips. 

- Explore the virtual internet world with the game's characters
The one-of-a-kind story system "iM" will lead the players and the in-game characters to slowly piece together the story and world behind "Cytus II". Reveal the truth of the story with a rich, cinematic visual experience. 

PAFF (CV:上坂すみれ Sumire Uesaka)
NEKO (CV:花守ゆみり Yumiri Hanamori)
Xenon (CV:関智一 Tomokazu Seki)
ConneR (CV:竹内栄治 Eiji Takeuchi)
Cherry (CV:ファイルーズあい Fairouz Ai)
Nora (CV:石見舞菜香 Manaka Iwami)
Ivy (CV:河瀬茉希 Maki Kawase)
Vanessa (CV:楠木ともり Tomori Kusunoki)
Rin (CV:能登麻美子 Mamiko Noto)

*************************************************************
Cytus II will perform a connection authentication for its In-app purchases from time to time.
If you discover during the authentication period that your IAP was lost due to your device not connecting to the internet, 
please make sure your device is connected to the internet. Afterwards, click "Restore Purchases" to recover your IAP.
*************************************************************
※ This game contains mild violence and vulgar language. Suitable for users age 15 and above.
※ This game contains additional in-app purchases. Please purchased base on personal interest and ability. Do not overspend.
※ Please pay attention to your game time and avoid addiction.
※ Please do not use this game for gambling or other illegal purposes.
